customer: Seriously, I just moved to Eastvale and I'm trying to sell my full-size SUV, but it has a rebuilt title from an old accident. Every place I try gives me the runaround, so can Northwind make me an offer or not?
agent: I'm sorry you've been getting the runaround, and I'll give you a straight answer. As explained in our article "Salvage and rebuilt titles," Northwind doesn't buy cars with salvage, rebuilt or flood titles, so with a rebuilt title we're unable to make an offer on your SUV. A branded title shows that a car was declared a total loss and possibly rebuilt afterward, which is why it falls outside what we purchase.
